title: Idle unload — params
description: Fires when a targeted deployment has had no requests for N minutes. Action: unload its instances (drain first) and free the GPU. Never fires for always_on models.

idle_minutes.title: N: idle for (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Minutes since the deployment's last request (deployments.last_request_at, updated by metering and by engine samples with active_sessions > 0).

min_loaded_minutes.title: Grace after load (minutes)
min_loaded_minutes.description: Never unload an instance that became ready less than this many minutes ago.

keep_replicas.title: Keep replicas
keep_replicas.description: Leave this many replicas running (0 = unload everything).

respect_time_windows.title: Only during
respect_time_windows.description: Optional windows (HH:MM-HH:MM in the rule timezone) in which the rule may fire; empty = always.
